chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When a man divorces his wife before consummating the marriage, there is no waiting period upon her; she may marry from that very moment if she wishes, and one divorce makes her irrevocably divorced; and if he had stipulated a dower for her, she is entitled to half of what he stipulated.
ai.seo_question: What are the rights of a wife divorced before consummation in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Reported by Shaykh al-Kulayni in al-Kafi, this hadith clarifies the fiqh of khulu' or talaq before consummation, establishing that the absence of sexual intercourse negates the obligation of the three-month waiting period (iddah), allowing for immediate remarriage. It further codifies the financial right of the wife to half the stipulated mahr, reflecting the principle of compensation for the sanctity of the marriage contract even without physical union. This ruling is foundational in Shia jurisprudence for distinguishing between the legal effects of the contract versus the act of consummation.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When the man divorces his wife before he consummated marriage, so there is no waiting period upon her. She can re-marry from that very moment if she so desires to, and one divorce would make her irrevocably divorced; and if a dower was Obligated for her, so for her would be half the obligation’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

If a man divorces his wife before going to bed with her, she does not need to wait for a waiting period. She can marry in the same hour after divorce if she wants. With one divorce she becomes stranger to him and if mahr (dower) is set for her, she deserves half of such mahr (dower)/”
